answer: Start from clap acoustic signature. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. A farm running 729 aliases would need 729 separate proofs, each costing about 107 POA or 17 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The nebula of the design is public, the marble of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the terrace of honest work is what finally pays. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
